captions.detailed: A compact fisheye prime lens featuring a bulging, semi-transparent domed front element and a thick matte black barrel. The mid-section features a ribbed manual focus ring that rotates around the barrel's central axis. At the base, a thin metallic-grey rear gel filter holder drawer is designed to slide outward, while a bayonet-style metal mounting plate finishes the rear connection.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a fisheye prime lens with a bulging domed front element, a short fat black barrel, a manual focus ring on a revolute joint around the mid-section, a sliding rear gel filter holder drawer on a prismatic joint at the base, and a bayonet rear mount plate.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens barrel using a lofted or stepped cylinder representing the outer housing. Build the front lens element as a semi-transparent dome using a revolved profile or a boolean intersection of a cylinder and sphere. Model the focus ring as an outer coaxial cylinder with ribbed cuts, and define a revolute joint relative to the barrel. Create the rear gel filter holder using thin box primitives, positioning it on a prismatic joint to allow linear sliding at the base, and finish with a thin metal cylinder for the bayonet mount.
